notes.title: Update Alpha 0.0.2
notes.content:
Hello to everybody,


I optimized the game so it has more FPS.
I also fixed a few mistakes.


I have added more vehicles. The Vehicle has a deformation.
I added better explosions.
I added more buildings to the CTA.
I added FlashBang, a Smoke Grenade.

I'm working on a virtual currency that you can use to buy everything in the game. You will earn this currency by playing the game. It mainly concerns the CTA mod. For that reason, registration is required.
You can come up with an email. It doesn't have to exist. However, it must be remembered, including the password.

No one is forcing anyone to register. You can play without it.

I am working on adding weapons, Vehicles, Buildings, and more tanks.



Thank you for purchasing the game.
FussyCraft
